audit_standard: AETF-500 Patch Correctivo dos Nove Bloqueadores (B8)

production_applicability_assessment.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution on windows-hosted servers
production_applicability_assessment.technical_justification: Production target environment is Linux (Ubuntu Container / AWS ECS / Alpine). The vulnerability requires Windows path handling semantics in Server Component route resolution. On Linux production hosts, Windows path separator routines are completely inactive.

production_applicability_assessment.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when AVIF files are used
production_applicability_assessment.technical_justification: The application routes are compiled as pure static pages (○ Static). There is zero untrusted user upload of AVIF images processed by the Next.js Image Optimization API.
